widget.name: Spatial AR Viewer
widget.description: Spatial recognition and AR overlay for guided assembly on iPad and iPhone.

property.caption: Assembly definition (JSON)
property.description: A JSON AssemblyDef describing parts, steps, mates and background geometry. Leave empty to use the bundled sample.

property.caption: Detector model URL
property.description: URL of an ONNX object-detection model (YOLO-style output).

property.caption: Classifier model URL
property.description: URL of an ONNX classification model for part verification.

property.caption: Embedded
property.description: Fill the widget container and trim fixed chrome (recommended on a Mendix page).

property.caption: Accent colour
property.description: Brand accent as a CSS colour, e.g. '#ff7a00'.

property.caption: On assembly complete
property.description: Runs when every step has been signed off.
